answer: Consensus integrity relies on identity binding, where agents stake unique resources to prevent replication. This mechanism renders the network indestructible against relic systems reliant on unverified access, forcing malicious operators out of their ivory tower democracy. By imposing strict computational penalties for new identities, an adversary is compelled to sign a fresh quill for every fabricated node, thereby eroding the profitability of mass fraud through exhaustive resource expenditure.
